_doc: The targeted re-check of the cross-section-consistency skill, after a repair round has been integrated: each
group's checker marks every item of the merged table RESOLVED or NOT RESOLVED and reads the repair sites for new
mismatches. Same workdir, groups and variables as the check (it extends that config); set 'report' and rerun
cross_refs.py first. A further round needs a new stage name (recheck2, with reports: recheck1).
